title: Identify the transported derived comparison
statement: The normalized transported comparison is equal to the supplied derived comparison.

source.place: Internal-Hom comparison, naturality of evaluation, and transposition paragraph; native refinement of lem-sf-weil-native-closed-forgetful.

proof.text: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: arbitrary NativeHomRepresentatives do not normalize a comparison. Negating the native representative model and the comparison preserves compatibility but changes the comparison on a nonzero internal Hom over characteristic-zero coefficients. Withdrawn; the parent now constructs its witnesses with m.derived itself.
